thread:
Erin Support: heads up — EDU-CUSTOMER (EU) submitted a PO for annual seats (PO# PO-4432) and was invoiced on 2026-02-01 (INV-2026-0234). They downgraded on 2026-05-01 and are asking for a partial refund. PO requires a credit note (no direct refunds). VAT handling looks messy (edu org claiming reduced VAT). Can finance advise the right way to issue a prorated credit note that will attach to the PO and keep our ledger clean? cc @Sam Billing @Andrew Finance

Sam Billing: got it. can you paste invoice lines and the dates? is the original payment actually closed (payment received) or still pending against the PO?

Erin Support: payment shows as "paid via PO" in the portal (billing-bot notes: PO matched, payment status: paid). Invoice summary: total 12,000.00 EUR (includes 20% VAT on taxable portion). Plan was annual, started 2026-02-01. Downgrade effective 2026-05-01 (after 3 months). Customer claims educational VAT exemption, but PO explicitly lists VAT amount so accounting flagged it. Quick numbers I calculated: 
```
price_per_month_net = 12000 / 12 / 1.20 = 833.33 EUR net/month
used_months = 3 => used_net = 3 * 833.33 = 2500.00 EUR
unused_net = 9 * 833.33 = 7500.00 EUR
VAT_on_unused = 7500 * 0.20 = 1500.00 EUR
gross_credit = 9000.00 EUR
```
They want a 9,000.00 EUR credit. But since PO states VAT was paid, we can't just zero VAT without documentation. Also PO terms say "no refunds; credits only".

Mia Ops: FYI our PO workflow expects a credit note referencing the original invoice and PO number. For the customer portal to apply the credit automatically we need the credit note to have the same tax treatment as the original invoice, otherwise it won't apply cleanly to the ledger/PO.

Andrew Finance: thanks for the calc, Erin. a few pieces: 1) confirm customer is B2B with a valid VAT or edu-exemption certificate; if they are VAT-exempt we must reissue invoice with the exemption (this is rare but possible). 2) because the payment method was PO (not card), we issue a credit note (CN) against INV-2026-0234 for the prorated gross amount (9000.00 EUR) and include the VAT line as originally charged unless we have a doc to reverse it. we should avoid issuing a cash refund.

Andrew Finance: suggested steps:
- create credit note referencing INV-2026-0234 and PO-4432
- CN lines: net -7500.00 EUR, VAT -1500.00 EUR, gross -9000.00 EUR
- include note: "Prorated credit for downgrade effective 2026-05-01 (9 months unused). Applied to PO-4432."
- if customer provides VAT exemption/certificate, reverse VAT on both original invoice and CN (create adjusting invoice + CN) — escalate to tax team.

Erin Support: ok. a couple edgecases: 1) customer already used some prepaid credits on new product add-ons (we need to net-off those before issuing credit), 2) PO approval chain requires our finance to attach a credit note PDF to a credit memos folder and email the purchaser contact.

Sam Billing: noted. For the portal automation to apply the CN to the PO record, please include metadata: {"po_number": "PO-4432", "related_invoice": "INV-2026-0234", "apply_auto": "true"}. I'll create the CN in the billing system and mark it "apply to PO".

billing-bot: automated check: matched PO-4432 to INV-2026-0234; payment recorded 2026-02-01; customer country: Germany; VAT charged: 20%.

Andrew Finance: one more accounting note — because this is a mid-cycle proration we need to tag the adjustment to the period when refund technically occurs (May 2026) and include both the net and tax amounts on the credit note PDF for audit. ledger codes to use: revenue_rev_rec (credit), vat_liability (credit), accounts_payable_po (debit). I'll add the exact GL mapping after I create the CN draft.

Mia Ops: if you want to test in staging before issuing, here's the minimal CN payload I used for a previous case (replace amounts and invoice id):
```
{
  "type": "credit_note",
  "reference_invoice": "INV-2026-0234",
  "po_number": "PO-4432",
  "lines": [
    {"description": "Prorated plan credit (9 months)", "net": -7500.00, "tax_rate": 0.20, "tax": -1500.00}
  ],
  "notes": "Apply to PO-4432. No cash refund."
}
```

Erin Support: i'll confirm whether they used any extra credits and ask for VAT exemption certificate. if they don't provide certificate we'll proceed with CN as Andrew suggested. i'll also prepare the email to the purchaser and attach the CN pdf when ready.

Sam Billing: i'll draft the CN in the billing system and ping @Andrew Finance for GL mapping review. please cc the customer's PO contact when sending.

Andrew Finance: I'll create the GL mapping and final review today. If tax team confirms exemption then we adjust original invoice and CN accordingly. otherwise we issue CN with VAT as charged.

Erin Support: thanks team — i'll update thread once customer replies. :thumbsup:
